Triplet: ["amlodipine", "has initial dose for geriatric hypertension", "2.5 mg once daily"]

The relation 'has initial dose for geriatric hypertension' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is prescribed an initial dose of the specified amount and frequency for treating hypertension in elderly patients.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires dietary management': The subject drug's effectiveness depends on adherence to the specified dietary regimen.
D. 'dose adjusted after': The dosage of the subject drug is modified following the specified event or condition.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
